lines.text: The prophet's heart is broken and his bones tremble because of the LORD's holy words, and the land mourns because of the curse.
The LORD found the wickedness of prophet and priest even in His house, and they will be driven away into Egypt.
The prophets of Samaria prophesied by Baal, and the LORD says Jerusalem's prophets are all like Nineveh to Him.
The LORD will feed the prophets wormwood and poisoned water, and tells the people not to listen to their false hopes.
The LORD did not send these prophets, and if they had stood in His council, they would have turned His people from evil.
